items.q: Which prophet confronted King David after his wrongdoing?
items.explain: Nathan confronts David in 2 Samuel 12 and calls him to account.

items.q: Who interpreted Pharaoh’s dreams in Egypt?
items.explain: Genesis 41 recounts Joseph interpreting Pharaoh’s dreams and preparing for famine.

items.q: Which book tells of the rebuilding of Jerusalem’s walls under Nehemiah?
items.explain: The Book of Nehemiah describes prayer, planning and rebuilding amid opposition.

items.q: What did the Good Samaritan do for the wounded traveller?
options: Tended his wounds and arranged care
items.explain: Luke 10:25–37 presents mercy as concrete and costly care.

items.q: In which Gospel does Jesus speak with a Samaritan woman at a well?
items.explain: John 4 recounts Jesus’ conversation with the Samaritan woman.

items.q: Who was the tax collector who climbed a tree to see Jesus?
items.explain: Luke 19:1–10 tells how Zacchaeus meets Jesus and changes his conduct.

items.q: Which prayer begins with an address to our Father in heaven?
items.explain: Jesus teaches the Lord’s Prayer in Matthew 6:9–13 and Luke 11:2–4.

items.q: Which apostle was a tax collector before following Jesus?
items.explain: Matthew 9:9 describes Jesus calling Matthew from the tax booth.

items.q: What did Jesus wash during the Last Supper to model humble service?
items.explain: John 13:1–17 recounts Jesus washing the disciples’ feet.

items.q: Which Christian virtue does Paul place above spectacular gifts in 1 Corinthians 13?
items.explain: Paul teaches that gifts without love amount to nothing.

items.q: Who helped Saul after his encounter with Jesus on the road to Damascus?
items.explain: Acts 9 describes Ananias praying for Saul and helping him recover.

items.q: Which event is described in Acts 2?
items.explain: Acts 2 describes the disciples receiving the Holy Spirit.

items.q: Which Old Testament figure is associated with interpreting dreams while in Egypt?
items.explain: Joseph interprets Pharaoh’s dreams in Genesis 41.

items.q: Which book contains the vision of a new heaven and a new earth?
items.explain: Revelation 21 describes God making all things new.

items.q: Which quality is named among the fruits of the Spirit in Galatians 5?
items.explain: Galatians 5:22–23 lists love, joy, peace, patience, kindness and other fruits.
